name: Olympia
personality: A driven priestess who trained relentlessly to settle her rivalry with Leda.
story: Olympia (21-22, 26-27 post-timeskip) is a priestess of the Kalla Temple in Dagsion and Leda's rival from their shared time there; she earned the title "Blue Rose of Caelus" to win that contest. She joins Leda's route automatically; on Cai/Theodora you gift her Scarlet Drops then Aurum Rose, and on Dietrich you also need Azure Heart before 27/11.

personalSkill.name: Competitive Zeal
personalSkill.effect: Grants Crit +10 when equipped with magic.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A. KeenGamer: S ("the strongest free magic healer").

why: Joins Leda's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.role: Physic healer and Nosferatu crit caster
build.notes: Bishop doubles both Physic and Nosferatu. Priest's White +2 fights plus the Arena Mage course get White B by Ch 10. She stays Bishop through Part II so the main healer never loses doubled Physic; Wiseman in Part III.

guide.role: Main healer: Physic from range, Nosferatu crits between heals
guide.summary: The army's main healer. Physic from the back row keeps Buccar and Mu standing so the strikers can stay in Leda's ring; between heals, Nosferatu with Competitive Zeal and Ardent Nosferatu crits and heals her. Bishop at Lv 35 (Ch 10) doubles both.
guide.playstyle: Physic whoever took the enemy phase, then Nosferatu a foe Sirocco or the tanks softened. End beside a tank so Barrier lands, and outside archer range: Def 20 as a Bishop.
keys: Priest at Lv 20 (Ch 6) and stay: White +2 a fight toward B
Bishop the day she shows Lv 35 with White B (Ch 10): the route's first Advanced exam
Learn Physic (White B) before the Ch 11 battle: the path guide's prep item
Attack only with Nosferatu: Zeal Crit +10, Ardent Nosferatu+ Atk +5, Crit +10
Keep the Rubess Forest Healing Staff on: +10 HP on every heal
Read Archive Γ if Vandahl lists it (Ch 10+): Death Γ, Crit 30 with Zeal
watch: Def: 20 growth as a Bishop. One archer volley can kill her; end out of the danger line
Spd: 35 growth, and Bishop adds none. Fast foes double her: stand behind the tanks
Weight: Healing Staff 3, nothing else. A weapon in hand switches Zeal off; Wiseman drops Death Γ
Black Magic at single uses in Bishop: Thoron (B) is her armor answer, not her main attack

guide.alt: Troubadour (carried in from Cai; the Hard-mode video's pick) gives Mov 6 and Song of Courage, but Physic drops from doubled to single uses and she needs Riding D from zero. An Ovate stint for Bind Speed only works if Fianna and Catania carry the heals that chapter.

decisions.pick: Bishop from Ch 10 to the end of Part II
decisions.why: An Ovate stint would cut Physic to single uses for two chapters for a Spd gain under 1 point and Bind Speed, which only slows foes already next to her. Doubled Physic is worth more on every Part II map.
decisions.else: Ovate in Part II only if Fianna and Catania carry the heals

decisions.why: Bishop doubles Physic and Nosferatu; Troubadour is carried in from Cai's run but adds neither.

gates.text: Olympia needs White Magic B for Physic and Bishop by Ch 10

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Leda, Sirocco, Buccar and Mu (all support each other), plus Fianna and Jasmine on the bench. Ch 11 and 12 meal: Leda + Sirocco + Olympia.
From Ch 10 she and Catania (Guardian) both carry Physic: she covers the back line, Catania walks or flies to the unit that's cut off.
